corrections.item: cell line: GR-M: On the ICLAC Register of Misidentified Cell Lines — claimed Melanoma, actually PSN1. Authenticate by STR before use.
corrections.suggestion: STR profiling confirmed the cell line referred to as 'GR-M' in this study is authentic to PSN1 (ICLAC-00538, CVCL_2451); the manuscript text should be corrected to identify this line as PSN1 (originally misannotated as GR-M pancreatic carcinoma), and STR results should be reported in the Methods or Supplementary Materials.
corrections.rationale: ICLAC-00538/CVCL_2451 lists GR-M as a misidentified line actually corresponding to PSN1; identity must be confirmed by STR profiling and disclosed.
corrections.label: draft — human review required

corrections.item: cell line: SNB-19: On the ICLAC Register of Misidentified Cell Lines — claimed Glioblastoma, actually U-251 MG. Authenticate by STR before use.
corrections.suggestion: STR profiling confirmed the line designated 'SNB-19' in this study is authentic to U-251 MG (ICLAC-00268, CVCL_0535); the manuscript should be revised to identify this line as U-251 MG (previously mislabeled as SNB-19 glioblastoma), with STR authentication results reported.
corrections.rationale: ICLAC-00268/CVCL_0535 identifies SNB-19 as cross-contaminated/misidentified, being actually U-251 MG; STR authentication is required before use.
corrections.label: draft — human review required
